notes: CIS Microsoft 365 Foundations Benchmark v7.0.0 recommendation numbers ('cis') are mapped only where a check clearly tests the same setting; unmapped checks have no CIS equivalent. SCF control IDs and NIST CSF 2.0 subcategories are best-fit mappings; validate against the SCF release (e.g. 2025.x) your client uses. NIST CSF 2.0 subcategory is the primary mapping per finding.

controls.name: Conditional Access policies in report-only mode
remediation: Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access > Policies.
Open each policy listed and review the report-only results under Insights and reporting.
When the impact is understood and break-glass accounts are excluded, set 'Enable policy' to On.
Retire report-only policies that are no longer needed.

controls.name: All-user Conditional Access policy without emergency (break-glass) exclusions
remediation: Create at least two cloud-only emergency access accounts (excluded from MFA-dependent policies, strong passwords stored offline).
Put them in a dedicated security group, e.g. 'CA-BreakGlass-Exclude'.
Entra admin center > Conditional Access > open each affected policy > Users > Exclude > select the group.
Alert on any sign-in by these accounts (Log Analytics / Sentinel / Defender XDR custom detection).

controls.name: No Conditional Access policy blocking legacy authentication
remediation: Entra admin center > Sign-in logs > filter Client app = legacy clients to find dependent apps first.
Conditional Access > New policy > Users: All users (exclude break-glass).
Target resources: All cloud apps. Conditions > Client apps: Exchange ActiveSync clients + Other clients.
Grant: Block access. Start in report-only, then enforce.

controls.name: No enforced Conditional Access policy requiring MFA for administrators
remediation: Conditional Access > New policy > Users: Directory roles (select all privileged roles) or All users.
Target resources: All cloud apps (or at minimum Microsoft Admin Portals).
Grant: Require authentication strength (Phishing-resistant MFA) or Require multifactor authentication.
Exclude break-glass accounts; test in report-only; enable.

controls.name: Privileged roles assigned permanently (not managed with PIM)
remediation: Entra admin center > Identity governance > Privileged Identity Management > Microsoft Entra roles > Assignments.
For each permanent active assignment: Add assignment as Eligible, then remove the permanent Active assignment.
Configure role settings: require MFA and justification on activation, set a maximum activation duration, require approval for Global Administrator.
Keep only the break-glass accounts as permanent Global Administrators.

controls.name: Stale enabled accounts (no sign-in for extended period)
remediation: Entra admin center > Users > All users > review each listed account with its owner/manager.
Block sign-in for confirmed unused accounts (Properties > Account enabled = No), then delete after the retention period.
Automate with Identity Governance Access Reviews or Lifecycle Workflows (leaver / inactivity).
Service and shared accounts: assign owners and exclude them only with documented justification.

controls.name: Member users not registered for MFA
remediation: Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > User registration details (filter MFA registered = No).
Enable the Microsoft Authenticator / FIDO2 methods and the registration campaign (Authentication methods > Registration campaign).
Create a Conditional Access policy 'Require MFA registration' (User action: Register security information) and a policy requiring MFA for all users.
Follow up with users who remain unregistered; disable accounts that are unused.

controls.name: Administrator accounts not registered for MFA
remediation: Contact each admin in the list and require registration of phishing-resistant MFA (FIDO2 key / Windows Hello / certificate-based auth).
Enforce the admin MFA Conditional Access policy so admins are prompted to register at next sign-in.
Use dedicated cloud-only admin accounts separate from day-to-day mailbox accounts.

controls.name: Stale eligible privileged role assignments
remediation: Entra admin center > Identity governance > Privileged Identity Management > Microsoft Entra roles > Assignments > Eligible assignments.
Remove eligible assignments for disabled or inactive accounts, or confirm each one with the role owner.
Set an expiry on eligible assignments and configure PIM access reviews (quarterly) for privileged roles.

controls.name: Mail auto-forwarding not blocked
remediation: Microsoft Defender portal > Email & collaboration > Policies > Anti-spam > Anti-spam outbound policy (Default).
Set 'Automatic forwarding' to Off - Forwarding is disabled.
For each mailbox listed with forwarding, remove the forwarding address (Exchange admin center > Recipients > Mailboxes > Manage mail flow settings).

controls.name: Mailbox auditing disabled organization-wide
remediation: Exchange Online PowerShell: Set-OrganizationConfig -AuditDisabled $false.
Confirm with Get-OrganizationConfig | Format-List AuditDisabled.

controls.name: Modern authentication disabled for Exchange Online
remediation: Exchange Online PowerShell: Set-OrganizationConfig -OAuth2ClientProfileEnabled $true.
Update any legacy Outlook clients before enforcing.

controls.name: SMTP AUTH enabled tenant-wide
remediation: Exchange admin center > Settings > Mail flow > tick 'Turn off SMTP AUTH protocol for your organization' (or: Set-TransportConfig -SmtpClientAuthenticationDisabled $true).
Enable SMTP AUTH per mailbox only for devices that cannot use OAuth (Set-CASMailbox -SmtpClientAuthenticationDisabled $false).

controls.name: Shared mailboxes allow direct sign-in
remediation: Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > select the shared mailbox account > Block sign-in.
Or: Set-MgUser -UserId <id> -AccountEnabled:$false.

controls.name: No custom anti-phishing policy
remediation: Microsoft Defender portal > Email & collaboration > Policies > Threat policies > Anti-phishing > Create policy.
Enable impersonation protection for key users and domains, mailbox intelligence, and a phishing threshold of 2 or higher; apply to all recipient domains.

controls.name: Safe Links not enabled for email, Office and Teams
remediation: Microsoft Defender portal > Email & collaboration > Policies > Threat policies > Safe Links.
Create or edit a policy enabling Safe Links for email, Office applications and Teams; turn on real-time URL scanning and do-not-track disabled.

controls.name: Teams external federation open to all domains
remediation: Teams admin center > Users > External access.
Set 'Choose which domains your users have access to' to 'Allow only specific external domains' (or block all external domains) and add approved partner domains.
Review which teams genuinely collaborate externally before restricting.

controls.name: Teams users can communicate with unmanaged (personal) Teams accounts
remediation: Teams admin center > Users > External access.
Turn off 'People in my organization can communicate with Teams users whose accounts aren't managed by an organization'.
Turn off 'External users with Teams accounts not managed by an organization can contact users in my organization'.

controls.name: Teams allows communication with trial tenants
remediation: Teams PowerShell: Set-CsTenantFederationConfiguration -ExternalAccessWithTrialTenants 'Blocked'.
Or Teams admin center > Users > External access > uncheck access to trial-only Microsoft 365 organisations.

controls.name: Anonymous users can join or start Teams meetings
remediation: Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > Global (Org-wide default) > Meeting join & lobby.
Set 'Anonymous users can join a meeting' to Off and 'Anonymous users and dial-in callers can start a meeting' to Off.

controls.name: Teams lobby can be bypassed by external or dial-in users
remediation: Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > Global > Meeting join & lobby.
Set 'Who can bypass the lobby' to 'People in my org' (or invited users / organisers only).
Set 'People dialing in can bypass the lobby' to Off.

controls.name: Anonymous users can use Teams meeting chat
remediation: Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > Global > Meeting engagement.
Set 'Meeting chat' to 'On for everyone but anonymous users' (or more restrictive).

controls.name: Anyone can present or external participants can take control in Teams meetings
remediation: Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > Global > Content sharing.
Set 'Who can present' to 'Only organizers and co-organizers' and 'External participants can give or request control' to Off.

controls.name: Third-party cloud storage enabled in Teams
remediation: Teams admin center > Teams > Teams settings > Files.
Turn off every third-party storage provider (Dropbox, Box, Google Drive, ShareFile, Egnyte) that is not an approved service.

controls.name: Email into Teams channels allowed
remediation: Teams admin center > Teams > Teams settings > Email integration.
Turn off 'Users can send emails to a channel email address'.

controls.name: Users cannot report security concerns in Teams
remediation: Teams admin center > Messaging > Messaging policies > Global > Report a security concern = On.
Also enable user reported settings in the Defender portal so reports reach the security team.

controls.name: Teams meeting recording enabled by default
remediation: Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > Global > Recording & transcription.
Turn off 'Meeting recording' in the Global policy and enable it only in a policy assigned to organisers who need it.

controls.name: Excessive number of Global Administrators
remediation: Entra admin center > Roles & admins > Global Administrator > review each assignment.
Move delegated tasks to least-privileged roles (e.g. Exchange, SharePoint, User, Security Administrator).
Target fewer than 5 Global Administrators (including 2 break-glass accounts), all PIM-eligible.

controls.name: Expired application or service principal credentials
remediation: Entra admin center > App registrations (or Enterprise applications) > open each app > Certificates & secrets.
Delete expired secrets/certificates; if the app is still in use, rotate to a new credential first.
Prefer certificates or federated credentials / managed identities over client secrets; limit lifetime to 6-12 months.
Assign two owners per app so rotation reminders reach a person.

controls.name: Application credentials expiring soon
remediation: Rotate the listed secrets/certificates before expiry (add new credential, update the consuming service, then remove the old one).
Set up Azure Monitor / Sentinel alerting or an automation on credential expiry.
Move to workload identity federation or managed identities where possible.

controls.name: Applications granted high-risk Microsoft Graph application permissions
remediation: Entra admin center > Enterprise applications > open the app > Permissions; review admin-consented application permissions.
Validate business need with the app owner; replace broad permissions (e.g. Directory.ReadWrite.All) with narrower alternatives or resource-specific consent (RSC / Sites.Selected).
Remove unused permissions and revoke admin consent for unknown apps.
Enable the admin consent workflow and restrict user consent (Enterprise applications > Consent and permissions).

controls.name: Guest accounts in role-assignable (privileged) groups
remediation: Entra admin center > Groups > open each listed group > Members; remove guest accounts unless there is a documented need.
Use Access Reviews on role-assignable groups with guests (Identity governance > Access reviews).
Restrict guest invitations (External Identities > External collaboration settings).

controls.name: Dynamic groups that automatically include guest accounts
remediation: Review the membership rule of each listed group and confirm what resources the group grants access to (apps, Teams, SharePoint, roles).
Narrow rules to specific guest populations (domain / attribute) rather than all guests.
Add access reviews for groups that grant access to sensitive content.

controls.name: Unresolved High severity security alerts
remediation: Microsoft Defender portal (security.microsoft.com) > Incidents & alerts > Alerts; filter Severity = High, Status != Resolved.
Triage each alert: classify (true/false positive), assign an owner, and investigate or remediate.
Enable automated investigation and response (AIR) and notification rules for high severity alerts.
Resolve alerts with a classification so the queue reflects real exposure.

controls.name: Unresolved High/Medium severity incidents
remediation: Defender portal > Incidents & alerts > Incidents; filter Status = New / In progress.
Assign owners, prioritise by severity and affected assets, and document the investigation.
Define SLAs for incident triage; review long-running incidents weekly.

controls.name: Non-compliant managed devices
remediation: Intune admin center (intune.microsoft.com) > Devices > Monitor > Noncompliant devices.
Open each device > Device compliance to see failing settings; remediate or retire the device.
Link compliance to Conditional Access (Require device to be marked as compliant) so non-compliant devices lose access.

controls.name: Managed devices without disk encryption
remediation: Intune admin center > Endpoint security > Disk encryption > Create policy (BitLocker for Windows, FileVault for macOS).
Add 'Require encryption of data storage on device' to the device compliance policy.
Verify recovery keys are escrowed in Entra ID.

controls.name: Microsoft Secure Score below target
remediation: Defender portal > Exposure management > Secure score; review Recommended actions sorted by points gained.
Prioritise actions with low user impact / low implementation cost first.
Track score movement monthly and record accepted-risk decisions.

controls.name: Secure Score improvement actions not fully implemented
remediation: Defender portal > Exposure management > Secure score > Recommended actions.
Open each action, follow the 'Implementation' steps, and set status to Completed / Risk accepted / Third-party as applicable.
Batch changes that share a portal (e.g. Exchange Online / Entra) to reduce change windows.

controls.name: High-value Secure Score actions not implemented
remediation: Treat these as the first remediation sprint: they carry the largest score gain.
Follow the implementation guidance linked in Secure score > Recommended actions for each control.
Pilot with a small group, communicate user impact, then roll out tenant-wide.

controls.name: Users can consent to any application (legacy user consent policy)
remediation: Entra admin center > Enterprise applications > Consent and permissions > User consent settings.
Select 'Do not allow user consent' (preferred) or 'Allow user consent for apps from verified publishers, for selected permissions'.
Enable the admin consent workflow so users can request approval.
Review existing consented apps under Enterprise applications > Permissions and revoke unknown grants.

controls.name: Admin consent request workflow disabled
remediation: Entra admin center > Enterprise applications > Consent and permissions > Admin consent settings.
Set 'Users can request admin consent to apps they are unable to consent to' = Yes.
Select reviewers (a small group of application/cloud application administrators) and set reminders and expiry.

controls.name: Unprivileged users can register applications or create tenants
remediation: Entra admin center > Identity > Users > User settings.
Set 'Users can register applications' = No and 'Restrict non-admin users from creating tenants' = Yes.
Delegate app registration to the Application Developer role for those who need it.

controls.name: Anyone, including guests, can invite external users
remediation: Entra admin center > External Identities > External collaboration settings > Guest invite settings.
Choose 'Only users assigned to specific admin roles can invite guest users' (or members only for collaborative tenants).
Pair with access reviews for guests.

controls.name: Guest user access is as permissive as member access
remediation: Entra admin center > External Identities > External collaboration settings > Guest user access.
Select 'Guest user access is restricted to properties and memberships of their own directory objects'.
Confirm no business process relies on guests enumerating the directory.

controls.name: Tenant-wide delegated consent granted for high-risk permissions
remediation: Entra admin center > Enterprise applications > open the app > Permissions > User consent / Admin consent tabs.
Revoke tenant-wide (AllPrincipals) grants for apps without a verified business need.
Replace broad scopes (Mail.ReadWrite, Files.ReadWrite.All, Directory.AccessAsUser.All) with narrower scopes.
Review sign-in logs of the app before revocation to avoid outages.

controls.name: Weak authentication methods (SMS / voice) enabled
remediation: Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Policies.
Disable SMS and Voice call (or target them only to groups that genuinely need them).
Move users to Microsoft Authenticator (number matching) or FIDO2 first; use the registration campaign.

controls.name: Microsoft Authenticator disabled or number matching off
remediation: Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Policies > Microsoft Authenticator.
Enable the method for all users and set 'Require number matching for push notifications' to Enabled.
Enable additional context (application name and location) to reduce MFA fatigue approvals.

controls.name: No phishing-resistant authentication method enabled (FIDO2 / certificate)
remediation: Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Policies > FIDO2 security key: Enable and target administrators first.
Optionally enable Certificate-based authentication; deploy Windows Hello for Business on managed devices.
Create an authentication strength requiring phishing-resistant MFA and use it in the admin Conditional Access policy.

controls.name: Custom banned password list not configured
remediation: Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Password protection.
Set 'Enforce custom list' = Yes and add organisation-specific terms (company, product, location names).
Set mode to Enforced; for hybrid tenants also deploy the on-premises Password Protection agent.

controls.name: No Conditional Access policy requires a compliant or managed device
remediation: Ensure devices are enrolled in Intune with a compliance policy.
Conditional Access > New policy > Users: All users; Target: Office 365 (or all apps); Grant: Require device to be marked as compliant (or Entra hybrid joined).
Start in report-only, exclude break-glass accounts, then enforce.

controls.name: No Conditional Access policy requires MFA for guest / external users
remediation: Conditional Access > New policy > Users > Include: Guest or external users (select all types).
Target resources: All cloud apps. Grant: Require multifactor authentication (or an authentication strength).
Configure cross-tenant access inbound trust to accept partner MFA if appropriate.

controls.name: No risk-based Conditional Access (sign-in risk / user risk)
remediation: Requires Entra ID P2 (Identity Protection).
Conditional Access > New policy > Conditions > Sign-in risk: Medium and above > Grant: Require MFA.
Add a user-risk policy: High risk > Require password change + MFA (or block).
Review Identity Protection > Risky users / Risk detections weekly.

controls.name: No location-based access controls (named locations)
remediation: Conditional Access > Named locations: define trusted countries/IP ranges.
Create a policy blocking sign-ins from countries where you have no users or business.
Require MFA for sign-ins from untrusted locations.

controls.name: Global Administrator activation settings are weak
remediation: Entra admin center > Identity governance > Privileged Identity Management > Microsoft Entra roles > Settings > Global Administrator > Edit.
Activation: set a maximum duration of 8 hours or less, require MFA (or authentication context) and justification.
Require approval from a second administrator where staffing allows; enable activation notifications.

controls.name: Cross-tenant access uses permissive defaults with no partner restrictions
remediation: Entra admin center > External Identities > Cross-tenant access settings.
Add organisational settings for known partners; consider blocking inbound B2B collaboration by default and allow-listing partners.
Enable inbound trust for MFA / compliant device claims only for partners you trust.

controls.name: Stale or unaccepted guest accounts
remediation: Entra admin center > Users > filter User type = Guest; review each listed account with the sponsor.
Delete invitations pending acceptance for more than 30 days and guests with no activity beyond your retention period.
Configure recurring access reviews for guests (Identity governance > Access reviews).

controls.name: Directory synchronisation is stale
remediation: On the Entra Connect server run Get-ADSyncScheduler and check SyncCycleEnabled and last run.
Review Entra admin center > Entra Connect > Connect Sync health and event logs for sync errors.
If Connect is decommissioned, disable directory synchronisation to avoid a stale source of authority.

controls.name: Users currently flagged at risk by Identity Protection
remediation: Entra admin center > Protection > Identity Protection > Risky users.
Investigate each at-risk user's risk detections; confirm compromise or dismiss with justification.
For confirmed compromise: reset credentials, revoke sessions, review recent activity and mail rules.

controls.name: No access reviews configured
remediation: Entra admin center > Identity governance > Access reviews > New access review.
Start with privileged role assignments, guest users and groups that grant access to sensitive resources.
Set a quarterly recurrence, reviewers (managers / owners) and auto-apply results.

controls.name: No Terms of Use configured
remediation: Entra admin center > Identity governance > Terms of use > New terms.
Upload the acceptable-use document and require acceptance for guests via Conditional Access (Grant: Require terms of use).

controls.name: No Microsoft Entra ID P1/P2 licensing in the tenant
remediation: Microsoft 365 admin center > Billing > Licenses; confirm which SKUs are purchased and assigned.
Conditional Access, PIM, Identity Protection and access reviews require Entra ID P1/P2 (included in Microsoft 365 Business Premium / E3 / E5).
Without these, enable Security Defaults as a minimum baseline.

controls.name: SPF missing or weak on email domains
remediation: DNS provider > add a single TXT record at the domain apex: v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com -all (plus any other legitimate senders).
Remove duplicate SPF records (only one is valid) and avoid +all / ?all.
Keep DNS lookups at 10 or fewer.

controls.name: DMARC missing or monitoring-only (p=none)
remediation: DNS provider > add TXT record _dmarc.<domain>: v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc-reports@<domain> to start monitoring.
Review aggregate reports, fix legitimate senders, then move to p=quarantine and finally p=reject.
Publish DMARC for every sending and non-sending domain (non-sending: v=DMARC1; p=reject).

controls.name: DKIM signing not configured for Exchange Online domains
remediation: Defender portal > Email & collaboration > Policies & rules > Threat policies > Email authentication settings > DKIM.
Select the domain, create DKIM keys and publish the two CNAME records (selector1/selector2._domainkey) at your DNS provider.
Return to the portal and enable signing for the domain.
